SolutionFaq.floristCore_q0: Do I need technical knowledge to set up Florist Core?
SolutionFaq.floristCore_a0: No. Setup is guided and takes under 30 minutes. Our onboarding team walks you through importing your products, configuring your storefront, and training your staff.
SolutionFaq.floristCore_q1: Can I migrate my existing orders and customer data?
SolutionFaq.floristCore_a1: Yes. We support CSV imports for products, customers, and order history. Our team can also assist with direct migrations from common platforms.
SolutionFaq.floristCore_q2: Is there a contract or minimum commitment?
SolutionFaq.floristCore_a2: Florist Core is billed monthly with no long-term contract required. You can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel at any time.
SolutionFaq.floristCore_q3: Does it work on mobile and tablet?
SolutionFaq.floristCore_a3: Fully. The interface is optimised for tablets (great for counter POS) and responsive on all mobile devices for on-the-go management.
SolutionFaq.floristCore_q4: What happens when I add more locations?
SolutionFaq.floristCore_a4: Multi-location support is included in the Pro tier. Each additional location gets its own inventory, staff, and order view, all manageable from your central admin.
SolutionFaq.dailyCloseAgent_q0: How does the agent pull my sales data?
SolutionFaq.dailyCloseAgent_a0: Daily Close Agent integrates directly with your Florist Core POS and online store. For third-party payment processors, we support Stripe, SumUp, and other common providers via API or CSV upload.
SolutionFaq.dailyCloseAgent_q1: What happens if there is a discrepancy?
SolutionFaq.dailyCloseAgent_a1: The agent flags the discrepancy, logs the amount and payment type, and sends an alert to the responsible manager. You can then resolve it within the platform and the resolution is recorded in the audit trail.
SolutionFaq.dailyCloseAgent_q2: Can I customise what the report includes?
SolutionFaq.dailyCloseAgent_a2: Yes. Pro and Enterprise tiers allow full report template customisation â€” choose the fields, groupings, and branding that match your internal standards.
SolutionFaq.dailyCloseAgent_q3: Is this compatible with my accounting software?
SolutionFaq.dailyCloseAgent_a3: Enterprise tier includes native Xero and DATEV integration. Pro tier exports clean CSV/PDF that can be imported into any accounting tool.
SolutionFaq.dailyCloseAgent_q4: Can my accountant access it directly?
SolutionFaq.dailyCloseAgent_a4: Yes. Pro tier includes a read-only accountant portal with secure login so your external bookkeeper can pull reports without accessing the full system.
SolutionFaq.monthlyCloseAgent_q0: How is this different from just running a monthly report in my POS?
SolutionFaq.monthlyCloseAgent_a0: Monthly Close Agent goes beyond a simple export. It validates figures, checks for gaps, maps to your GL accounts, runs variance checks, and produces a formatted close pack â€” in a fraction of the time.
SolutionFaq.monthlyCloseAgent_q1: Can it handle accruals and adjustments?
SolutionFaq.monthlyCloseAgent_a1: Yes. You can enter manual accrual entries and prepayment adjustments within the agent. These are tracked separately and included in the final close pack.
SolutionFaq.monthlyCloseAgent_q2: How long does a typical monthly close take with this?
SolutionFaq.monthlyCloseAgent_a2: Most businesses complete their close in under 2 hours. Previously this could take 1â€“3 days of manual work.
SolutionFaq.monthlyCloseAgent_q3: Can multiple people work on the close at the same time?
SolutionFaq.monthlyCloseAgent_a3: Yes. Pro tier supports concurrent access with role-based permissions â€” a preparer can work on figures while a reviewer checks completed sections.
SolutionFaq.monthlyCloseAgent_q4: Does it integrate with my existing accounting software?
SolutionFaq.monthlyCloseAgent_a4: Enterprise tier includes native Xero, DATEV, and SAP integration. Other tools can be connected via CSV export or our open API.
SolutionFaq.quarterlyCloseAgent_q0: Do I need to complete monthly closes before running a quarterly close?
SolutionFaq.quarterlyCloseAgent_a0: Ideally yes â€” Quarterly Close Agent is designed to build on top of Monthly Close Agent data. However, you can also use it as a standalone tool by importing your own monthly figures.
SolutionFaq.quarterlyCloseAgent_q1: How do I upload my budget for actuals-vs-plan tracking?
SolutionFaq.quarterlyCloseAgent_a1: You can upload a quarterly budget via CSV or enter it directly in the agent interface. The budget can be updated at any point during the quarter.
SolutionFaq.quarterlyCloseAgent_q2: Can I share the quarterly pack externally?
SolutionFaq.quarterlyCloseAgent_a2: Yes. The pack is generated as a branded PDF or interactive web view that you can share via secure link â€” no recipient login required.
SolutionFaq.quarterlyCloseAgent_q3: Does the forecasting module require historical data?
SolutionFaq.quarterlyCloseAgent_a3: At least two prior quarters of data produces the best signals. The module will generate a basic forecast with just one quarter of history and improves over time.
SolutionFaq.quarterlyCloseAgent_a4: Pro and Enterprise tiers allow you to customise the checklist with your own jurisdiction-specific tasks, internal control requirements, and approval workflows.
SolutionFaq.yearlyCloseAgent_q0: Can I use Yearly Close Agent if I haven't used the daily or monthly agents?
SolutionFaq.yearlyCloseAgent_a0: Yes. You can import your own annual data via CSV or connect your existing accounting software. The agents work best together but each can also operate independently.
SolutionFaq.yearlyCloseAgent_q1: How does the year-end rollover work?
SolutionFaq.yearlyCloseAgent_a1: Once you confirm the year is closed, the agent archives all records for the period, posts opening balance entries for the new year, and resets all period accumulators â€” all with a full audit trail.
SolutionFaq.yearlyCloseAgent_q2: Is the output suitable for my external auditor?
SolutionFaq.yearlyCloseAgent_a2: Enterprise tier includes an auditor access portal and a formatted statutory accounts pack. For Pro and below, you receive a comprehensive PDF and Excel pack that most auditors accept directly.
SolutionFaq.yearlyCloseAgent_q3: Can I compare this year against the previous two or three years?
SolutionFaq.yearlyCloseAgent_a3: Yes. Once you have two or more years of data in the system, the comparative view extends to however many prior years you have on record.
SolutionFaq.yearlyCloseAgent_q4: What happens to my data after the year is closed?
SolutionFaq.yearlyCloseAgent_a4: Closed-year data is archived but fully accessible at any time. You can re-open a closed period for corrections if needed â€” with all changes logged in the audit trail.
SolutionFaq.managedSecuredWorkplace_q0: What devices and operating systems do you support?
SolutionFaq.managedSecuredWorkplace_a0: We support Windows 10/11, macOS 13+, iOS, and Android. All major device types are covered â€” laptops, desktops, tablets, and smartphones.
SolutionFaq.managedSecuredWorkplace_a1: For most businesses under 50 users, full workplace enrolment and configuration is completed within 5â€“10 business days. Larger deployments are scoped individually.
SolutionFaq.managedSecuredWorkplace_q2: Do employees need to do anything?
SolutionFaq.managedSecuredWorkplace_a2: Minimal. Staff install a lightweight management agent and complete MFA setup â€” the rest is handled transparently in the background with no impact on their daily workflow.
SolutionFaq.managedSecuredWorkplace_a3: Yes. Our platform is EU-hosted, and the management policies are designed to align with GDPR data protection principles. We provide documentation for your compliance records.
SolutionFaq.managedSecuredWorkplace_q4: What happens if a device is lost or stolen?
SolutionFaq.managedSecuredWorkplace_a4: We can remotely lock, wipe, or revoke access to any managed device within minutes â€” ensuring company data cannot be accessed even if the physical device is compromised.
SolutionFaq.managedSoc_q0: What does "24/7 monitoring" actually mean in practice?
SolutionFaq.managedSoc_a0: Our analysts work in rotating shifts covering all time zones. Automated detection runs continuously, and any high-severity alert triggers an immediate analyst review â€” day or night, including weekends.
SolutionFaq.managedSoc_q1: How do you connect to my environment?
SolutionFaq.managedSoc_a1: We ingest logs from your existing sources â€” Microsoft 365, Azure AD, firewalls, endpoints, and servers â€” using read-only API integrations or lightweight agents. No changes to your production systems are required.
SolutionFaq.managedSoc_q2: What happens when an incident is confirmed?
SolutionFaq.managedSoc_a2: You receive an immediate alert via your preferred channel (email, Teams, phone). Our analyst provides a summary of the threat, what has been done to contain it, and a clear next-steps remediation guide.
SolutionFaq.managedSoc_q3: Can Managed SOC work alongside our existing IT team?
SolutionFaq.managedSoc_a3: Yes â€” and it's the most common setup. Your IT team handles day-to-day operations and remediation; our SOC handles detection, triage, and response guidance. We operate as a seamless extension of your team.
SolutionFaq.managedSoc_q4: How is this different from an antivirus or a firewall?
SolutionFaq.managedSoc_a4: Antivirus and firewalls are preventative tools. Managed SOC is a detection and response capability â€” it assumes some threats will get through and ensures they're caught, contained, and investigated before causing damage.

SolutionContent.floristCore_tagline: The complete operating system for your flower shop
SolutionContent.floristCore_overview: Florist Core brings every part of your business into one clean platform. From the moment a customer places an order to the final delivery confirmation, every workflow — inventory, team management, subscriptions, reporting — runs in one unified experience so you can focus on what you do best.
SolutionContent.floristCore_benefit_0_body: Handle walk-in, online, and delivery orders from a single dashboard. No more switching between tabs or tools.
SolutionContent.floristCore_benefit_1_body: Live stock levels, low-stock alerts, and automated reorder thresholds so you never run short on your bestsellers.
SolutionContent.floristCore_benefit_2_body: Build predictable revenue with flexible subscription plans — weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly — with automated scheduling and billing.
SolutionContent.floristCore_benefit_3_body: Daily, weekly, and monthly sales reports with bestseller rankings, peak hour trends, and customer retention metrics.
SolutionContent.floristCore_benefit_4_body: Assign roles, manage shifts, track task completion, and keep your team aligned — whether you have 2 staff or 20.
SolutionContent.floristCore_benefit_5_body: Automated SMS and email updates at every order milestone — confirmation, dispatch, and delivery — keeping customers informed effortlessly.
SolutionContent.floristCore_useCase_0_desc: Running a single shop and tired of juggling spreadsheets, WhatsApp orders, and paper invoices? Florist Core replaces all of it with one clean system.
SolutionContent.floristCore_useCase_1_desc: If most of your orders are online or subscription-based, the dispatch board and automated customer comms give you full control without the admin overhead.
SolutionContent.floristCore_useCase_2_desc: Manage inventory, staff, and orders across multiple branches from a single HQ view — with per-location reporting and permissions.
SolutionContent.floristCore_useCase_3_desc: Handle large recurring corporate accounts with dedicated CRM profiles, volume pricing, and automated invoicing built into the platform.
SolutionContent.dailyCloseAgent_tagline: Automated end-of-day reconciliation — finished before you lock up
SolutionContent.dailyCloseAgent_overview: Daily Close Agent automates your end-of-day financial reconciliation so your team spends less time on manual tallying and more time on the business. Every sales figure, payment method, and discrepancy is captured, reconciled, and reported by the time your doors close.
SolutionContent.dailyCloseAgent_benefit_0_body: Pulls data from POS, online orders, and payment processors automatically — no manual entry at the end of the day.
SolutionContent.dailyCloseAgent_benefit_1_body: A live dashboard shows exactly where you stand throughout the day so there are no surprises at close time.
SolutionContent.dailyCloseAgent_benefit_2_body: Instant notifications when figures don't match — flagging cash differences, missing transactions, or payment mismatches before they escalate.
SolutionContent.dailyCloseAgent_benefit_3_body: Clean, audit-ready PDF or CSV reports emailed automatically to managers and accountants at the end of each business day.
SolutionContent.dailyCloseAgent_benefit_4_body: Every action is logged with timestamps and user attribution — giving you a tamper-proof record for compliance and accountability.
SolutionContent.dailyCloseAgent_benefit_5_body: Compare today's close figures against last week, last month, or any custom date range to spot patterns early.
SolutionContent.dailyCloseAgent_useCase_0_desc: You close alone every night after a long day. Daily Close Agent does the reconciliation while you're cashing up — so the report is ready the moment you're done.
SolutionContent.dailyCloseAgent_useCase_1_desc: Get a consolidated end-of-day summary across all locations in one view without chasing branch managers for their daily numbers.
SolutionContent.dailyCloseAgent_useCase_2_desc: Receive clean, consistent daily exports that drop straight into Xero or DATEV — cutting manual data entry down to near zero.
SolutionContent.dailyCloseAgent_useCase_3_desc: A complete, timestamped audit trail for every transaction and close action — ready for tax authorities or internal audit at any time.
SolutionContent.monthlyCloseAgent_tagline: Month-end made effortless — close your books with confidence
SolutionContent.monthlyCloseAgent_overview: Monthly Close Agent consolidates all daily and weekly activity into a clean, verified month-end package. It validates figures, surfaces discrepancies, aligns with your chart of accounts, and delivers a review-ready report to your finance team — cutting close time from days to hours.
SolutionContent.monthlyCloseAgent_benefit_0_body: Automatically aggregates all daily revenue, cost of goods, and expense data into a complete monthly profit & loss view.
SolutionContent.monthlyCloseAgent_benefit_1_body: A structured, role-based checklist ensures no close step is skipped — from bank reconciliation to accrual adjustments.
SolutionContent.monthlyCloseAgent_benefit_2_body: Maps your sales categories to your chart of accounts automatically, keeping your general ledger clean without manual journal entries.
SolutionContent.monthlyCloseAgent_benefit_3_body: Generates a fully formatted, shareable monthly close pack — perfect for management review, board reporting, or external accountants.
SolutionContent.monthlyCloseAgent_benefit_4_body: Highlights month-over-month variances above your defined thresholds so you can investigate before the report leaves your desk.
SolutionContent.monthlyCloseAgent_benefit_5_body: Breaks down COGS, waste, and margin by product category so you know exactly where your profitability is strongest each month.
SolutionContent.monthlyCloseAgent_useCase_0_desc: Stop chasing data from multiple systems. Monthly Close Agent pulls everything together and gives you a verified package to present to leadership.
SolutionContent.monthlyCloseAgent_useCase_1_desc: Receive a clean, consistent monthly pack from your florist clients — no more back-and-forth requesting missing figures.
SolutionContent.monthlyCloseAgent_useCase_2_desc: Consolidate financials across multiple branches into one monthly report without manually merging spreadsheets.
SolutionContent.monthlyCloseAgent_useCase_3_desc: Get a clear monthly breakdown of cost-of-goods, waste, and category margins so you can make product and pricing decisions with real data.
SolutionContent.quarterlyCloseAgent_overview: Quarterly Close Agent guides your finance team through every step of the quarter-end process — from performance reviews to KPI validation. It produces board-ready summaries, ensures compliance checkpoints are met, and keeps your business on track between annual closes.
SolutionContent.quarterlyCloseAgent_benefit_0_body: Tracks your most important business metrics — revenue, margin, order volume, and customer retention — across all four quarters side by side.
SolutionContent.quarterlyCloseAgent_benefit_1_body: Automatic YTD roll-ups so you can compare Q1 vs Q2 vs Q3 performance without building custom pivot tables.
SolutionContent.quarterlyCloseAgent_benefit_2_body: Built-in checklist of tax and regulatory checkpoints relevant to your jurisdiction — ensuring nothing is missed before quarter close.
SolutionContent.quarterlyCloseAgent_benefit_3_body: Upload your quarterly budget once and the agent tracks actuals vs plan automatically, highlighting over and under-performances.
SolutionContent.quarterlyCloseAgent_benefit_4_body: One-click generation of a clean quarterly pack with executive summary, charts, and commentary — ready to present to investors or leadership.
SolutionContent.quarterlyCloseAgent_benefit_5_body: The agent analyses seasonal patterns and current-quarter trends to generate a lightweight next-quarter forecast so planning starts earlier.
SolutionContent.quarterlyCloseAgent_useCase_0_desc: Produce a complete, board-ready quarterly pack without assembling data from three different systems across a weekend.
SolutionContent.quarterlyCloseAgent_useCase_1_desc: Meet quarterly reporting obligations to investors and lenders with clean, consistent, and credible financial output.
SolutionContent.quarterlyCloseAgent_useCase_2_desc: See exactly where you're running over or under budget each quarter — before the year-end review catches you off guard.
SolutionContent.quarterlyCloseAgent_useCase_3_desc: Consolidate quarterly results across branches into a single group view with location-level drill-downs for deeper analysis.
SolutionContent.yearlyCloseAgent_tagline: Annual close done right — every year, without the chaos
SolutionContent.yearlyCloseAgent_overview: Yearly Close Agent orchestrates your entire year-end process — from final reconciliation and tax preparation to statutory reporting and annual review. It consolidates twelve months of data, validates every line, and guides your team through a structured close so the year ends cleanly and confidently.
SolutionContent.yearlyCloseAgent_benefit_0_body: Aggregates all twelve months of revenue, COGS, operating expenses, and net profit into a complete annual financial statement.
SolutionContent.yearlyCloseAgent_benefit_1_body: Produces a structured tax prep pack including revenue summaries, deductible expense breakdowns, and VAT/GST reconciliation.
SolutionContent.yearlyCloseAgent_benefit_2_body: Structures output in formats aligned with local statutory reporting requirements — ready for your auditor or company secretary.
SolutionContent.yearlyCloseAgent_benefit_3_body: Automatically places this year's figures next to last year's for every key metric — the standard format for statutory accounts.
SolutionContent.yearlyCloseAgent_benefit_4_body: One-click new financial year setup — carries forward opening balances, resets period counters, and archives the closed year cleanly.
SolutionContent.yearlyCloseAgent_benefit_5_body: Side-by-side view of budget vs actual for the full year, plus a pre-built template to set your next financial year's targets.
SolutionContent.yearlyCloseAgent_useCase_0_desc: Transform your annual close from a stressful multi-week scramble into a structured process you can actually plan around.
SolutionContent.yearlyCloseAgent_useCase_1_desc: Hand your auditor a complete, well-organised annual pack on day one of fieldwork — shortening the audit and reducing back-and-forth.
SolutionContent.yearlyCloseAgent_useCase_2_desc: Use the prior-year analysis and next-year planning templates to build a credible budget for bank financing or investor discussions.
SolutionContent.yearlyCloseAgent_useCase_3_desc: Consolidate subsidiaries and branches into a single group annual report with full intercompany eliminations handled automatically.
SolutionContent.managedSecuredWorkplace_tagline: A protected, policy-driven workplace — managed for you end to end
SolutionContent.managedSecuredWorkplace_overview: Managed Secured Workplace takes the complexity of securing your team's devices, identities, and collaboration tools off your plate entirely. We design, deploy, and continuously manage a hardened workplace environment — so your staff work productively and your business stays protected without needing an in-house IT security team.
SolutionContent.managedSecuredWorkplace_benefit_0_body: Every laptop, desktop, and tablet is enrolled, configured, and continuously monitored under a unified management policy — Windows, macOS, and mobile covered.
SolutionContent.managedSecuredWorkplace_benefit_1_body: Centralised identity management with MFA enforcement, single sign-on (SSO), and least-privilege access policies applied across all applications.
SolutionContent.managedSecuredWorkplace_benefit_2_body: Policies that prevent sensitive business data from being emailed, copied, or shared outside your organisation — automatically enforced at the endpoint.
SolutionContent.managedSecuredWorkplace_benefit_3_body: CIS and industry benchmark configurations applied to all devices on day one — closing the most common attack vectors before they can be exploited.
SolutionContent.managedSecuredWorkplace_benefit_4_body: Automated OS and application patching keeps your entire fleet up to date. Critical patches are deployed within defined SLA windows.
SolutionContent.managedSecuredWorkplace_benefit_5_body: Encrypted VPN, secure DNS, and split-tunnelling policies ensure your remote and hybrid staff connect safely from anywhere.
SolutionContent.managedSecuredWorkplace_useCase_0_desc: You're onboarding new staff every month but don't have an IT team. We handle device setup, access provisioning, and security policies from day one.
SolutionContent.managedSecuredWorkplace_useCase_1_desc: Staff scattered across offices and home setups need consistent, enforced security — regardless of where or what device they're working from.
SolutionContent.managedSecuredWorkplace_useCase_2_desc: Meet GDPR, ISO 27001, and industry data handling requirements with a documented, auditable security baseline across your entire workforce.
SolutionContent.managedSecuredWorkplace_useCase_3_desc: Moving off old on-premise infrastructure? We design and migrate your workplace to a modern, cloud-managed, secure foundation.
SolutionContent.managedSoc_tagline: 24/7 threat detection, triage, and response — without building your own team
SolutionContent.managedSoc_overview: Our Managed Security Operations Center gives your business enterprise-grade cyber defence without the cost of an in-house SOC team. Around the clock, our analysts and automated detection systems monitor your environment, triage every alert, and respond to confirmed threats — so you can focus on running your business while we keep it safe.
SolutionContent.managedSoc_benefit_0_body: Continuous monitoring of your network, endpoints, cloud workloads, and identity systems — every hour of every day, including weekends and public holidays.
SolutionContent.managedSoc_benefit_1_body: Our analysts filter, correlate, and prioritise alerts so your team only acts on confirmed, high-confidence incidents — not thousands of raw security events.
SolutionContent.managedSoc_benefit_2_body: When a real threat is confirmed, our response team acts immediately — containing the threat, preserving evidence, and guiding your team through remediation.
SolutionContent.managedSoc_benefit_3_body: Enriched detection using global threat intelligence feeds — so we identify known attacker infrastructure, malware signatures, and emerging campaign patterns before they reach you.
SolutionContent.managedSoc_benefit_4_body: Clear, executive-readable monthly reports covering incidents detected, actions taken, threat trends, and your security posture improvement over time.
SolutionContent.managedSoc_benefit_5_body: Continuous discovery and assessment of your exposed assets — identifying unpatched systems, misconfigured services, and new vulnerabilities before attackers do.
SolutionContent.managedSoc_useCase_0_title: The Business Without a Security Team
SolutionContent.managedSoc_useCase_0_desc: You have IT support but no dedicated security staff. Managed SOC gives you the equivalent of a fully staffed security operations centre at a fraction of the cost.
SolutionContent.managedSoc_useCase_1_desc: Financial services, healthcare, or public sector? Meet NIS2, ISO 27001, and sector-specific monitoring requirements with a fully documented, auditable SOC service.

PosTerminal.heroBody: POS Terminal gives your counter staff a fast, touch-optimised system that captures every sale, updates stock instantly, and feeds your end-of-day close — without a single manual step.
PosTerminal.challengeTitle: Running the counter without the right tools is costing you more than you think
PosTerminal.challengeBody: Every florist knows the rush — three customers waiting, a phone ringing, and staff trying to manually note a sale while calculating change. The result? Lost orders, stock that never matches reality, and a close that never quite adds up.
PosTerminal.pain0body: Paper-based or memory-based orders get forgotten during busy periods — especially walk-ins and last-minute custom requests.
PosTerminal.pain1body: Without automatic deduction, counter sales never reach your inventory — leaving you blind to what's actually on the shelf.
PosTerminal.pain2body: Manual cash reconciliation, cross-checking receipts, and totalling by hand drags your close time well past your working hours.
PosTerminal.howTitle: From counter to close in four steps
PosTerminal.step0body: Staff picks products from the visual catalogue or keys in a custom arrangement in seconds — no scrolling, no searching.
PosTerminal.step1body: Cash, card, contactless, or split — all handled in the same interface with built-in Stripe Terminal support.
PosTerminal.step2body: Every item sold deducts from inventory in real time — keeping your online store and back-of-house counts in perfect sync.
PosTerminal.step3body: Every transaction feeds Daily Close Agent — so by the time you lock up, your reconciliation report is waiting.
PosTerminal.whyTitle: The business impact of a proper POS
PosTerminal.adv0title: Serve more customers in the same time
PosTerminal.adv0body: Touch-optimised product selection, one-tap favourites, and smart modifiers let your staff ring through a sale in under 10 seconds. On Valentine's Day or Mother's Day, that difference is the queue walking out happy — or walking out.
PosTerminal.adv0pt0: Visual product catalogue with category tabs
PosTerminal.adv0pt1: Pre-loaded bundle shortcuts for peak days
PosTerminal.adv1body: Every counter sale deducts from the same inventory pool shared with your online store. No more over-selling, no more apologetic calls — just accurate stock across every channel, automatically.
PosTerminal.adv1pt1: Low-stock alerts before you run out
PosTerminal.adv2title: Every sale becomes a business insight
PosTerminal.adv2body: POS Terminal doesn't just process payments — it builds a picture of your business. Which products sell fastest on Saturdays? What's your average basket size this month vs last? The data is there, automatically.
PosTerminal.adv2pt1: Bestseller rankings by day, week, or month
PosTerminal.integBody: Every counter sale flows into the wider Florist Portal — keeping your entire business in sync without you lifting a finger.
PosTerminal.integ0body: Stock levels update the moment a sale is made — no manual counting, no end-of-day adjustments.
PosTerminal.integ1body: Every POS transaction is pre-reconciled — your end-of-day close report is ready the moment you stop selling.
PosTerminal.integ2body: Walk-in buyers are added to your CRM, their purchase history saved, and loyalty points applied automatically.
PosTerminal.integ3body: The same product catalogue powers both your counter and your online storefront — one source of truth, always consistent.
PosTerminal.whoTitle: Built for every kind of florist business
PosTerminal.uc0body: Most of your sales happen face-to-face. POS Terminal gives your staff a clean, fast interface that handles any transaction without slowing down the queue.
PosTerminal.uc1body: Online orders and walk-ins share the same inventory pool. POS Terminal keeps everything in sync automatically — no double-entry, no overselling.
PosTerminal.uc2body: On Valentine's Day or Mother's Day, speed is everything. Pre-loaded bundles and one-tap product buttons let your team serve more customers in less time.
PosTerminal.uc3body: Run two or more tills during busy periods — each synced to the same product catalogue, inventory, and CRM without conflict or duplication.
PosTerminal.faqBody: Everything you need to know before getting started.
PosTerminal.faq0q: What hardware does the POS Terminal run on?
PosTerminal.faq0a: It runs in the browser on any tablet or touch-screen PC. We support iPad, Android tablets, and Windows touch displays out of the box — no proprietary hardware required.
PosTerminal.faq1a: A limited offline mode is available for core sales. Transactions queue locally and sync automatically the moment connectivity is restored.
PosTerminal.faq2q: Can I customise the product layout on the POS screen?
PosTerminal.faq2a: Yes. You can organise products into categories and set quick-access shortcuts for your best-sellers — making the counter experience as fast as possible for your staff.
PosTerminal.faq3q: How does POS Terminal connect to my card reader?
PosTerminal.faq3a: We support Stripe Terminal hardware directly. For other card readers, contact us about compatibility — most industry-standard readers are supported.
PosTerminal.faq4q: Does POS Terminal replace my online store?
PosTerminal.faq4a: No — they are complementary. POS Terminal and your online storefront share the same product catalogue and inventory, so you manage one source of truth rather than two separate systems.
PosTerminal.ctaTitle: Ready to transform your counter experience?
PosTerminal.ctaBody: POS Terminal is included with Florist Core — no extra setup, no separate billing.

TeamPage.member4Bio: Owns platform resilience, compliance alignment, and secure-by-default operations across all customer environments.

TeamPage.value2: Stable delivery over rushed feature volume
